findings.title: Region admins cannot see other managers' shifts or cover requests at their assigned pharmacies.
findings.scenario: Lina assigns Grace to manage Tom's pharmacy as a region admin with roster privileges, without adding a separate pharmacy-admin appointment. When Tom posts shifts, Grace's active, confirmed and history lists omit them, although the individual pharmacy permission check recognizes her authority. Omar's cover requests are also unavailable to Grace, preventing her from handling staffing work within her assigned region.
findings.test_needed: Assign Grace roster-capable region membership without a PharmacyAdmin record; verify Tom's shifts and Omar's cover request are accessible only within her assigned pharmacies.

owner_question.question: When Lina gives Grace region-admin roster privileges for Tom's pharmacy, should Grace see Tom's shifts and decide Omar's cover requests?
options: Grace can manage this work through her region assignment.
Grace needs a separate pharmacy-admin appointment to manage others' work (keep today's behaviour).
